title: [Refurb] Viture Pro XR/AR Glasses 135" 120hz 1000Nits $186.15 Delivered @ Viture AU eBay
body:
Deal: [Refurb] Viture Pro XR/AR Glasses 135" 120hz 1000Nits $186.15 Delivered @ Viture AU eBay

[LilSlip] By the time it took me to look up a comparison, it was already gone.
[TuiTorpedo88] Sorry you missed out, but love your invention…..just saying =-)
[ArtOfTheDeal] I have the better version of these, the Luma. The output really does depend on your device, if you have a phone it will just display as your phone turned sideways unless you use VLC. I have used it on the plane and it does feel a bit special but you also feel you look like a douche. The 3D mode and the Airwalker app are hot garbage and are practically a non-feature unless you're connected to a high-end PC, which defeats the use-case.
Be forewarned, the Chinese Bot Army is strong with this brand and any opinions short of this being the Second Coming Of Christ are met with heavy reactions.
[fantombloo] opinions short of this being the Second Coming Of Christ are met with heavy reactions
I can't wait to use this somewhere. I think I already know where.
[WaveZero] I tried the Beast and Luma Ultra. The Beast had color fringing at the edges; the native 3DoF was nice, but drifting was an issue. While the Luma Ultra was advertised as 3DoF and 6DoF, they weren't native and only worked via SpaceWalker or neckband or something device. Clarity was better on the Luma Ultra, but the resolution was still low enough for me to notice the pixelation, and drifting remained an issue. I returned them all to Viture initially, they didn't want to cover my shipping costs, but after complaining, they refunded them…
If you can try them at JB, that's your best option.. Advice is to wait another couple of years for the technology to mature.
[teatea] If using on PC. Spacewalker is extremely slow and rubbish for sure. I prefer using VertoXR. Not as feature packed, but works much better than Spacewalker.
[Pinchy] It depends on the app. On my iphone some streaming apps have the controls on the phone, while the video plays on the glasses.
[wishing well] The 3D mode is great. I say that as a 3D stereographer who bought a pair for the purpose (R5 with RF 5.2mm f/2.8, dual RX100 VI's, dual RX0 II's, dedicated 3D macro rig, etc).
I also have a decent library of Hollywood Blu-ray 3D movies that I watch on the glasses (VR too). Agree the app is a mess but the 3D mode doesn't need the app. Just long press the right button and watch SBS content from the phone (vlc works fine). Honestly it's a blessing being able to experience 3D on a pair of glasses that aren't anaglyph (red/blue). And oled to boot!
Sorry but this is basic functionality that you should probably understand before rolling out the "bot army" wankery. You're obviously trying very hard to sound like an authority but that's no excuse. "Be forewarned" indeed…
[misunderstood98] It seems alot of people write off 3d features because they confuse it with the VR ecosystem rather than associate it with the niche 3d film market. It makes sense though, as the 3d market basically died at the same time the vr market launched, so they are often mistakenly compared when they are inherently different elements of the visual media spectrum (spatial world vs layered image/holographic diorama).
The knowledge gap will shift in coming years given the "3d 2.0" movement of glasses-less 3d options and funnily enough, the integration into the VR ecosystem (which had a somewhat positive reception due to the heavy investment from meta/valve/Sony).
[smarter_fool] I highly recommend these, I have realised that as I am getting older holding the phone and watching something in bed is a health hazard. Phone battery takes a massive hit.
[FlipperMeTimbers] and you think this emf blasting machine next to your brain is better for your health?
[Domingo] What's the health hazard? Phone corner in the eyeball?
[krisspy] I've dropped a surface 3 on my face, have a gangsta scar on my upper lip now
[teatea] You can get one of those adapters that split video out and charging.
[thousandsuns] Have the beast, pretty awesome Tech but still on the fence as it seems wonky in terms of performance. Still testing.
[Save Medicare] For those who missed out, if you get a good upsized cashback then the xreals are pretty well priced on aliexpress
